result.title: HRoPE: Homography Relative Positional Encoding
result.summary: Geometric Relative Positional Encoding has become the primary mechanism for injecting spatial inductive biases into multi-view transformers. Existing designs condition attention on camera-level frustums or ray-marched depth, associating cross-view tokens through the sensor geometry. Such sensor-centric formulations, however, describe only where a token is observed from, leaving the rich surface geometry of the scene region depicted by the token. In this paper, we advocate a shift toward surface-aware positional encoding that explicitly grounds patch tokens in the geometry of physical surfaces. We introduce HRoPE, which represents the local geometry of each patch as a slanted 3D plane, following the slanted support-window assumption of classical multi-view stereo. We inject token-level, plane-induced homographies into attention as relative transformations. This equips the transformer with a geometric prior for rectifying perspective distortions and aligning patch features across viewpoints. Our encoding requires no ground-truth geometry: the plane parameters can be predicted end-to-end under a view-synthesis objective alone, or derived from foundation models. Extensive experiments on RealEstate10K, CO3Dv2, and DL3DV show that our best variant of HRoPE consistently outperforms the evaluated geometric positional encodings for novel view synthesis. Extensive ablations and analysis show the effectiveness of the proposed encoding. Please refer to our project page at: https://gaohchen.github.io/HRoPE

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HRoPE，将每个 patch 的局部几何建模为倾斜三维平面，并把平面诱导的单应性作为相对变换注入注意力，用于多视角 Transformer 的新视角合成，无需真值几何即可端到端训练。
AI.relevance_reason: 其以 token 级相对几何变换偏置注意力的做法，可供核查如何把表面级空间关系写入内部状态，从而缓解多视角视觉信息在 VLM 表征中的几何与透视失真；但研究任务是新视角合成而非推理，迁移性需自行判断。
